hook.title: We built our own *Earth* instead of using Cesium

scenes.title: Ground *tracks*
scenes.caption: where it passes over, orbit by orbit

caption:
The easy move was Cesium. We wanted to understand every number on screen, so we wrote the Earth model ourselves. (Burnline is a build with a friend.)

Every dot is a real satellite from the public catalog. The SGP4 propagator is compiled to WebAssembly, so the whole thing runs in your browser.

What satellite should we follow in the next video?
